documents.title: Character translation for noisy subtitles
documents.text: We study machine translation of misspelled subtitles from French into English. A character encoder reduces untranslated words, while human raters still find errors in jokes.

documents.title: Terminology constraints in medical translation
documents.text: Our translation system preserves a bilingual glossary when translating clinical instructions. Automatic terminology scores improve, but reviewers find grammatical errors around constrained phrases.

documents.title: Low resource translation with aligned phrases
documents.text: We align small parallel corpora to train a translation model for a low resource language. Phrase retrieval helps rare expressions and fails when word order differs greatly.

documents.title: Measuring gender errors in translation
documents.text: This study evaluates gender agreement in translated occupational sentences. Counterfactual source pairs reveal systematic translation errors hidden by an aggregate BLEU score.

documents.title: Document context for pronoun translation
documents.text: A document translation model uses neighboring source sentences to resolve pronouns. Context improves selected ambiguous examples but can propagate a mistaken earlier reference.

documents.title: Interactive translation with human corrections
documents.text: Translators correct partial machine translations in an editing interface. The system adapts suggestions to accepted edits, reducing repeated terminology errors in a small pilot.

documents.title: Synthetic parallel text for translation
documents.text: We create parallel training examples through back translation of monolingual news. Translation quality improves in the news domain but remains weak on informal conversation.

documents.title: Translation evaluation beyond word overlap
documents.text: Human judges compare adequacy and fluency for translated legal sentences. A learned translation evaluator agrees with some preferences while overlooking omitted negations.

documents.title: Code switched machine translation
documents.text: A bilingual translation benchmark mixes Spanish and English within sentences. Translation systems preserve named entities poorly when the input switches language near a proper noun.

documents.title: Constrained decoding for translation names
documents.text: We constrain machine translation decoding to retain product names. The translation model respects most constraints but occasionally repeats the required phrase.

documents.title: Parallel corpus filtering with embeddings
documents.text: Sentence embeddings identify mismatched source and target sentences in a parallel translation corpus. Filtering improves later translation training while discarding some valid paraphrases.

documents.title: Evaluating translation of idioms
documents.text: We compare literal and meaning preserving translations of common idioms. Expert evaluation finds that fluent machine translations can still reverse the intended meaning.

documents.title: Noise robust speech recognition
documents.text: We evaluate automatic speech recognition on recordings with traffic noise. Acoustic augmentation reduces word error rate, but distant microphones still cause deletion errors.

documents.title: Accents in automatic transcription
documents.text: A speech recognizer transcribes speakers with different regional accents. Disaggregated word error rates reveal uneven recognition performance despite a good overall score.

documents.title: Streaming speech recognition latency
documents.text: We compare streaming acoustic encoders for live transcription. Smaller audio windows reduce recognition latency but lose words near utterance boundaries.

documents.title: Domain adaptation for spoken commands
documents.text: An acoustic speech recognizer adapts to factory commands using a small audio corpus. Recognition improves for familiar machinery terms and remains unreliable under alarms.

documents.title: Speaker overlap in meeting transcription
documents.text: A meeting transcription pipeline separates overlapping voices before speech recognition. Speaker attribution improves, though simultaneous speech still produces missing words.

documents.title: Whispered speech recognition
documents.text: We study recognition of whispered audio with limited acoustic training data. A recognizer trained on normal speech misses consonants and benefits from targeted whispered examples.

documents.title: Confidence estimates for speech transcripts
documents.text: We evaluate confidence scores from an automatic speech recognizer. High confidence sometimes accompanies substitutions of rare names, motivating manual review of critical utterances.

documents.title: Microphone transfer in speech recognition
documents.text: The same speech recordings are captured with phone and headset microphones. Recognition errors shift with microphone response, especially for soft consonants.

documents.title: Disfluencies in speech transcription
documents.text: A speech recognizer is tested on hesitations and false starts in interviews. Removing disfluencies improves readability but can erase evidence needed for linguistic analysis.

documents.title: Vocabulary bias in audio transcription
documents.text: We bias a speech recognition decoder toward a domain vocabulary. Rare technical words become easier to recognize, but similar sounding common words are sometimes replaced incorrectly.

documents.title: Child speech acoustic modeling
documents.text: An automatic speech recognition system is evaluated on children reading short stories. Acoustic differences and pronunciation variation produce higher word error rates than adult speech.

documents.title: Speech recognition after audio compression
documents.text: We transcribe audio saved at several compression levels. Aggressive compression distorts acoustic cues and increases recognition errors for quiet speakers.

documents.title: Faithfulness in news summarization
documents.text: We compare generated summaries against news source documents. Human annotators identify unsupported claims even when automatic overlap metrics reward the summaries.

documents.title: Long document summarization with sections
documents.text: A summarization model selects evidence from sections of long reports. Coverage improves over truncating the input, but conclusions from tables are often omitted.

documents.title: Query focused meeting summaries
documents.text: We generate meeting summaries conditioned on a user question. Relevant decisions are easier to find, while summaries sometimes omit disagreement among participants.

documents.title: Extractive summarization under a word budget
documents.text: An extractive summarizer selects source sentences under a fixed length budget. Redundancy penalties improve coverage, although selected sentences can contain unresolved references.

documents.title: Evaluating scientific abstract summaries
documents.text: Experts evaluate summaries generated from scientific articles. Concise outputs often preserve the research question while overstating uncertain experimental conclusions.

documents.title: Summarization of customer conversations
documents.text: We summarize long support conversations into issue and resolution fields. The summarizer sometimes mistakes an unsuccessful proposed fix for the final resolution.

documents.title: Citation support in generated summaries
documents.text: A summarization system attaches source sentence citations to each generated claim. Citation presence alone does not establish that the referenced passage supports the summary.

documents.title: Controlling summary length
documents.text: We compare instruction based and constrained decoding methods for summary length. Short summaries meet the requested budget but may omit conditions required to interpret a result.

documents.title: Summarizing conflicting documents
documents.text: A multi document summarizer receives reports with contradictory observations. Generated summaries often merge incompatible statements instead of preserving the disagreement.

documents.title: Human editing of machine summaries
documents.text: Editors correct generated summaries of policy documents. Editing time falls for well structured inputs but increases when fluent summaries contain subtle factual changes.

documents.title: Entity preservation in summarization
documents.text: We test whether a summarizer preserves names, dates, and quantities from source reports. Copying entities reduces some mistakes but does not prevent incorrect relations between them.

documents.title: Summary evaluation with targeted questions
documents.text: Question answering probes check whether generated summaries preserve source evidence. Some summaries score well on word overlap while failing questions about causes and exceptions.

documents.title: Summaries of translated interviews
documents.text: We translate spoken interviews and then summarize the translated transcripts. Translation omissions and speech recognition errors can silently change the final summary.

documents.title: Speech to translated summaries
documents.text: An audio pipeline recognizes speech, translates the transcript, and produces a concise summary. We inspect how acoustic errors propagate into translation and summarization.

documents.title: Cross language summary evaluation
documents.text: Bilingual judges evaluate summaries written in a different language from the source. They separate translation errors from missing information in the summary.

documents.title: Garden irrigation with soil sensors
documents.text: A field study schedules irrigation using soil moisture sensors. Battery failures and local soil variation complicate estimates of water savings.

documents.title: Ceramic glazes at high temperature
documents.text: We measure color changes in ceramic glazes across kiln temperatures. Small differences in cooling rate affect the final surface texture.

documents.title: Orbital debris tracking
documents.text: A telescope system estimates trajectories of orbital debris from repeated night observations. Cloud cover causes gaps in the measurements.

documents.title: Bread fermentation under cool conditions
documents.text: We compare sourdough fermentation at several kitchen temperatures. Dough expansion varies with starter age and flour hydration.

documents.title: Urban bicycle lane safety
documents.text: We inspect intersection designs along a city bicycle route. Observed conflicts depend on traffic volume and turning visibility.

documents.title: Uncertain labels for interdisciplinary studies
documents.text: This exploratory note discusses whether a document about translated speech summaries belongs to one research area. Several plausible descriptions emphasize different parts of the same pipeline.
